title: A Love at the Airport
content:
Sophie was waiting for her flight at the airport. She had her suitcase beside her and her passport in her hand.

A young man sat next to her. He was holding his phone and looking at the departure board.

— Is this your flight? — he asked.

— Yes, it is. What about your flight?

— Mine is going to London.

Sophie smiled.

— Mine is going to London too!

They started talking about their trips.

Soon, Sophie heard an announcement.

— That is my flight! — she said.

She picked up her suitcase.

The young man looked at her.

— Maybe we will see each other in London.

Sophie smiled.

— I hope so.

She walked toward the gate, but then she turned around.

— Wait! What's your name?

— Daniel. And your name?

— Sophie.

They smiled at each other.

Their flights were the beginning of an unexpected love story.
